canonical_exact_scope: For every natural cap and binary infinite word s, there exist an infinite retained vertex set, an actual eligible permanent-binary-gender population with at most cap children per vertex and finite actual roots, and avoidance of s from every starting vertex, iff cap≥2 and s is not eventually periodic. Nonroots have parents of each gender and chronology/finite-prefix conditions are retained. Below two no eligible infinite population exists. The directed line graph of the original P_s has exactly three roots, exactly two children per vertex and two opposite-gender parents at every nonroot, with full infinite-word language preserved without a shifted first letter. The unlabelled graph is fixed across targets; only genders change. The same actual retained witness is specieslike, an inspecies and reflective. Three-root optimality is not part of the result.

theorem exact_threshold (cap : Nat) (s : Nat → Bool) :
    (∃ E S g, FixedGenderPopulation E S g cap ∧
      ¬ FixedGenderReindex.RealizesOn E S g s) ↔
      2 ≤ cap ∧ ¬ EventuallyPeriodic s

theorem actual_three_root_two_child_avoider (s : Nat → Bool) (hs : ¬ EventuallyPeriodic s) :
    FixedGenderPopulation Arc Vertices (gender s) 2 ∧
    (∀ x, Vertices x → ∃ a b, a ≠ b ∧ Vertices a ∧ Vertices b ∧
      ∀ y, Arc x y ↔ y = a ∨ y = b) ∧
    (∀ y, (Vertices y ∧ Root (Induced Arc Vertices) y) ↔ y = 1 ∨ y = 2 ∨ y = 3) ∧
    ¬ FixedGenderReindex.RealizesOn Arc Vertices (gender s) s

theorem actual_parent_ids (x y : Nat) (hy : 2 ≤ source y) :
    Arc x y ↔ x = 2 * source y - 2 ∨ x = 2 * source y - 3

theorem each_gender_parent (s : Nat → Bool) (y : Nat) (hy : Vertices y)
    (hsource : 2 ≤ source y) (b : Bool) :
    ∃ x, Vertices x ∧ Arc x y ∧ gender s x = b

theorem full_unshifted_language (s word : Nat → Bool) :
    FixedGenderReindex.RealizesOn Arc Vertices (gender s) word ↔
      BinaryPopulation.Realizes (BinaryAvoidance.Edge s) word

theorem cap_two_unavoidability (s : Nat → Bool) :
    FixedGenderReindex.FixedGenderUnavoidable 2 s ↔ EventuallyPeriodic s

theorem same_actual_specieslike_inspecies_reflective_witness (s : Nat → Bool)
    (hs : ¬BinaryAvoidance.EventuallyPeriodic s) :
    FixedGenderPopulation Arc Vertices (CapTwo.gender s) 2 ∧
    Specieslike (Induced Arc Vertices) Vertices ∧
    Inspecies (Induced Arc Vertices) Vertices ∧
    Reflection (Induced Arc Vertices) Vertices ∧
    ¬FixedGenderReindex.RealizesOn Arc Vertices (CapTwo.gender s) s
